name: start_claude
description: Start a new Claude coding session. Default: current directory, new tab.

directory.description: Working directory exactly as stated. Omit for here or current directory.

place.description: New tab by default, or a split in the named direction.

task.description: Initial task text, copied exactly; omit unless requested.

model.description: Model name exactly as stated; omit unless requested.

name: start_codex
description: Start a new Codex coding session. Default: current directory, new tab.

directory.description: Working directory exactly as stated. Omit for here or current directory.

place.description: New tab by default, or a split in the named direction.

task.description: Initial task text, copied exactly; omit unless requested.

model.description: Model name exactly as stated; omit unless requested.

name: wait_for_agent
description: Wait for an existing agent to finish its current turn. Does not start an agent.

directory.description: Directory identifying the existing session. Omit for here.

name: message_agent
description: Send exact text to an existing agent. Does not start an agent.

directory.description: Directory identifying the existing session. Omit for here.

name: open_app
description: Open a known application. A file can be opened in the PDF viewer.

file_path.description: Explicit PDF file path, copied exactly; omit when no file is named.
